column2: Retain Gorgias’s five thousand men and one thousand picked cavalry, with the army moving at night. The selection adjective belongs to the cavalry phrase; do not spread it automatically to all troops.
Retain the surprise attack as purpose and men from the citadel as guides. Sons of the citadel is contextual membership, not literal birth inside the fortress.
Retain Judas hearing and setting out with the mighty men against the royal force at Emmaus. The verse continues into the temporal circumstance in verse 4.
Retain while the forces were still scattered away from camp. The temporal qualification should not become a separate claim that the army had been permanently dispersed.
Retain Gorgias finding no one and searching the mountains because he believed they were fleeing. His speech remains a character’s interpretation of the empty camp.

Retain daybreak, three thousand men and inadequate protective equipment and swords relative to their wishes. Protective equipment provisionally leaves the coverings term broader than a definite shield type.
column3: Does the coverings term specifically identify shields, other armour or protective gear collectively? The current breadth is not a settled material identification.

column2: Retain the strong armoured army, surrounding cavalry and training for war. These details explain the soldiers’ apprehension without asserting exact formations.
Retain the two prohibitions: fear of numbers and loss of courage before the assault. No guarantee of an effortless battle is introduced.
Retain the fathers’ rescue in the Red Sea and Pharaoh’s pursuit with a force. The Greek has the sea’s colour designation; do not replace it with another textual tradition.

Retain crying to Heaven and the tentative perhaps He will favour us, remember the fathers’ covenant and crush the army today. The conditional/indirect-question opening is not made an unconditional divine promise.
Retain all nations knowing there is One redeeming and saving Israel. One renders the substantival expression; the source does not supply a proper divine name here.
Retain the foreigners raising their eyes and seeing the approaching men opposite. The embodied seeing formula remains, with its military perspective.
Retain the enemy leaving camp and Judas’s men sounding the trumpet. The subject change is explicit in the second clause and must not assign the trumpet to the enemy.
Retain engagement, the nations being crushed and their flight into the plain. The passive defeat is not expanded with an unstated agent.

Retain all rearward men falling, pursuit to Gazera and the plains associated with Idumea, Azotus and Jamnia, and about three thousand fallen. The local all is not made a claim that the entire enemy force died.
Retain Judas and his force returning from the pursuit. This prepares the warning against premature plunder rather than completing the whole battle narrative.
Retain the prohibition on coveting spoils and battle still before them. The spatial idiom naturally expresses the pending confrontation.
Retain nearby Gorgias, the command to stand/fight and taking spoils freely afterward. The time sequence must remain; freely renders the confidence/open freedom term provisionally.
Retain a detachment appearing from the mountain while Judas finishes speaking. Looking out preserves the emergence/peering image without naming an unmentioned officer.

Retain the detachment’s collective seeing and the visible smoke as evidence of the rout and burning. Their men and the passive was being burned are contextual clarifications of Greek subjects left implicit.
column3: Should a closer draft preserve the active plural they are burning? The inherited passive avoids deciding that referent but obscures the source’s active construction; full subject analysis remains pending.

column2: Retain their extreme fear and the further sight of Judas’s army ready on the plain. Keep the dependent sentence flowing into their flight in verse 22.
Retain all of this group fleeing into foreign territory. The selected foreign designation is not automatically harmonized with the named Philistines of 3:24.
Retain Judas’s return followed by plural plundering, with gold, silver, blue and sea-purple cloth and wealth. Cloth is contextual for colour/material terms; sea-purple preserves the source qualifier.
Retain it is good for the printed neuter formula, rather than replacing it with the familiar He is good. Keep His mercy for ever and display introduction, first clause and mercy clause separately.
column3: What is the precise force of the neuter good in this elliptical hymn: impersonal goodness, an act of praise or another supplied subject? The current wording remains provisional.

column2: Retain great deliverance for Israel on that day. The Greek event construction does not name an additional military actor.
Retain escaped foreigners reporting everything to Lysias. Survival and report are sequential, and everything is limited to what happened in this encounter.
Retain confusion and discouragement and both failures: his wishes for Israel and the king’s command. The parallel negative clauses should not be reduced to only one disappointment.
Retain the following year, sixty thousand picked men and five thousand cavalry. Do not import a calendar year or harmonize this count with another battle account.
Retain entry into Idumea, Beth-zur encampment and Judas’s ten thousand. The place forms remain provisional selected-text equivalents, without reconstructing a route.

Retain Thou/Thy in the explicit prayer, the mighty man’s assault, David’s hand, and Jonathan with his armour-bearer. Four display lines separate the introduction, blessing and two recalled rescues; no Goliath name is inserted.
Retain shutting the army into Thy people’s hand and shame over force and cavalry. Two display lines preserve petition and consequence; the hand image remains singular.
Retain cowardice, melting the boldness of their strength and shaking at their collapse. Three display lines retain each petition, including the difficult nested strength expression.
column3: How best to express boldness of strength without flattening its genitive relation? The current phrasing remains a close provisional draft.

column2: Retain the sword of those loving Thee and praise by all who know Thy name. Two lines preserve the movement from defeat to hymns; direct divine address governs the sacred pronouns.
Retain about five thousand from Lysias’s army and the repeated they fell before them. Repetition is present in the source and should not be silently edited away as redundant.

Retain Lysias’s rout, Judas’s troops’ courage and readiness to live or die nobly, then retreat and renewed mercenary recruitment. The alternative live or die is not reduced to willingness only to die.
Retain Behold, defeated enemies and the proposal to cleanse and dedicate the holy places anew. The explicit attention marker remains, with no modern festival name inserted.
Retain the whole army gathering and ascending Mount Zion. Whole applies to this assembled force, not an inferred national population.

Retain sanctuary, altar, burned gates, wild growth in courts and demolished chambers. The comparison with a thicket or mountain preserves two alternatives; chambers remains a provisional architectural term.
Retain torn garments, a great lament and ashes. On themselves supplies the natural object of putting on ashes without importing the head specified elsewhere.
Retain falling face down to the ground, signal trumpets and a cry to Heaven. The instrument’s signaling role remains distinct from the earlier general trumpet reference.
Retain Judas ordering fighting at the citadel while cleansing continues. He had cleansed reflects the singular subordinate verb, while subsequent priestly agency is not denied.
Retain blameless priests devoted to the law. The willing/devoted expression is not expanded into an unmentioned certification or hereditary qualification.
Retain cleansing holy places and carrying stones of defilement to an unclean place. These stones are not automatically identified with the altar stones considered separately in verses 44–46.
Retain deliberation over the profaned whole-burnt-offering altar. Its exact fate remains the question here, preceding the decision in the next unit.

Retain the decision to pull it down to avoid reproach because nations defiled it. The English considered it best naturally expresses the good counsel arriving to them without adding divine instruction.
Retain storing the stones on the house’s mountain until a prophet can answer about them. No prophet is named and the indefinite future resolution remains open.
Retain whole stones under the law and a new altar like the former. Whole is not replaced by a more specific construction technique without lexical review.
column3: Does whole here require the conventional unhewn interpretation, or is undamaged completeness the immediate force? Retain the broader wording provisionally.

column2: Retain rebuilding holy places and the house’s interior, then consecrating the courts. The two verbs and their respective objects remain distinct.
Retain new holy vessels and bringing lampstand, incense altar and table into the temple. The vessel category is not reduced to only one of the listed furnishings.
Retain incense on the altar and lighting lamps on the lampstand, followed by their shining in the temple. The lamps, not the human attendants, supply the natural final subject.
Retain loaves, spread curtains and completion of all undertaken work. No bread count or curtain measurement is supplied.
Retain early morning, day twenty-five, ninth month Chislev and year 148. The parenthetical month identification is preserved without a modern-date conversion.
Retain sacrifice according to law on the new whole-burnt-offering altar they made. This distinguishes the restored altar from the one dismantled earlier.

Retain dedication at the matching season/day of profanation, with songs and three instrument categories. The precise identities of harps and lyres remain provisional, not interchangeable by assumption.
Retain all people prostrate and blessing toward heaven the One who prospered them. The directional construction remains visible instead of replacing heaven with an unexpressed proper name.
column3: How should the heaven-directed blessing and its personal accusative object be balanced in fluent English? The inherited construction is not final literary acceptance.

column2: Retain eight days, joyful whole burnt offerings and sacrifice of well-being and praise. The singular sacrifice expression is not automatically split into a prescribed count of separate offerings.
Retain golden crowns, small shields, renewed gateways/chambers and fitting doors. Small shields reflects the diminutive without inventing their material or exact dimensions.
Retain exceedingly great gladness and reversal of the nations’ reproach. The passive reversal is not assigned an expressly named actor absent from the clause.
Retain Judas, brothers and whole assembly establishing annual eight-day observance from Chislev twenty-five. Both gladness and joy remain; later terminology is not imported.

Retain high walls and strong towers around Zion to prevent renewed trampling by nations. Them provisionally preserves the plural object rather than silently replacing it with a single named sanctuary.
column3: What does the plural object encompass: fortified holy places, the site’s structures or another contextual group? The English does not resolve the antecedent.

column2: Retain the force stationed there and the difficult fortification/guarding sentence involving Beth-zur and Idumea. Do not silently recast the selected syntax into two smoothly independent fortress projects.
column3: How do the repeated it, fortifying and guarding Beth-zur connect? The inherited sentence remains explicitly provisional pending fuller syntactic and apparatus review.
